title_zh: 美联储主席沃什讲话（加息后首次公开表态）
title_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks (first remarks since the rate meeting)
desc_zh: 美联储主席沃什在旧金山联储生产力与就业会议上发表开幕讲话（美东时间 12:00，北京时间 11 月 17 日凌晨 1:00），是 10 月议息会议后他的首次公开表态；市场关注他对 12 月是否加息的暗示。
desc_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives opening remarks at a San Francisco Fed conference on productivity and jobs (12:00 p.m. ET) — his first public remarks since the October rate meeting; markets watch for hints on a December hike.

title_en: YOM ($YOM) trading opens with matched airdrop
desc_zh: 10 月 28 日 TGE 后，$YOM 于 11 月 17 日开放交易，并向 4 月锁仓参与者同步发放空投；同日 NANO 设备开售。按官方渠道操作，谨防钓鱼网站。
desc_en: After the Oct 28 TGE, $YOM starts trading on Nov 17 with a matched airdrop for April lock-up participants; NANO device sales open the same day. Use official channels only.

title_zh: 英伟达发布 Q3 财报（黄仁勋辞职后首份）
title_en: Nvidia Q3 earnings (first report since Huang's resignation)
desc_zh: 英伟达按原计划于 11 月 17 日（周二）发布 2026 财年第三季度财报；CEO 黄仁勋 11 月 12 日突然辞职后，这是临时 CEO Colette Kress 掌舵后的首份财报，市场关注 AI 芯片需求与管理层指引。
desc_en: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 results on Nov 17 as scheduled — the first report since CEO Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation on Nov 12, with interim CEO Colette Kress at the helm; markets watch AI chip demand and management guidance.

title_zh: 美国 10 月零售销售发布
desc_zh: 美国人口普查局发布 10 月零售销售（美东时间 8:30，北京时间 21:30），市场预期环比持平（9 月 +0.8%）；消费数据直接影响 12 月加息预期与风险资产情绪。
desc_en: The US Census Bureau releases October retail sales (8:30 a.m. ET) — markets expect flat month-on-month after a 0.8% rise in September. Consumer spending data feeds directly into December hike expectations and risk-asset sentiment.
Released 2:00 PM ET. Reveals internal debate on the rate path.
desc_zh: 北京时间 11 月 19 日凌晨 3:00 公布，透露官员对利率路径的分歧。
title_zh: 美联储 10 月会议纪要

desc_en: KieDex, a crypto futures and spot exchange on Base, plans its TGE on Nov 18 with a fixed 1B KDX supply and 37% reserved for community rewards. Dates and terms per official announcements — beware of phishing.

desc_zh: 约 2360 万枚 ZRO 解锁，价值约 4500 万美元，占流通量约 5.9%，释放给核心贡献者与战略伙伴，比例较高，潜在抛压需警惕。
desc_en: ~23.6M ZRO unlock (~$45M, ~5.9% of circulating supply) to core contributors and strategic partners — a high ratio; watch for potential sell pressure.

title_zh: Anthropic 股票纳斯达克首日交易（640 亿美元 IPO）
title_en: Anthropic shares begin trading on Nasdaq ($64B IPO)
desc_zh: Anthropic 股票 11 月 19 日起在纳斯达克交易，IPO 规模约 640 亿美元；本周 AI 板块资金面与风险情绪的重要风向标，留意其对英伟达等 AI 股与加密市场的传导。
desc_en: Anthropic shares start trading on Nasdaq on Nov 19 after a ~$64B IPO — a key sentiment gauge for AI stocks this week; watch the knock-on effects on Nvidia and crypto risk appetite.

title_zh: 参议院银行委员会听证 SEC 提名人 Johnson 与 Levine
title_en: Senate Banking Committee hearing for SEC nominees Johnson and Levine
desc_zh: 参议院银行委员会于美东时间 11 月 19 日 10:00 听证 SEC 提名人 Kristin Johnson 与 Steven Levine；两人分别接替 Crenshaw 与 Peirce 的席位。加密市场结构法案 CLARITY 已在参议院停滞，本届国会 1 月 3 日换届前须完成确认，否则提名将被退回；听证表态值得留意，但听证不等于确认。
desc_en: The Senate Banking Committee hears SEC nominees Kristin Johnson and Steven Levine at 10:00 a.m. ET on Nov 19; they would succeed Crenshaw and Peirce. The CLARITY Act has stalled in the Senate, and confirmations must complete before Congress turns over on Jan 3 or the nominations are returned; watch what the nominees say, but a hearing is not a confirmation.

desc_zh: FABLES 积分领取与 PROLOGUE 兑换于 11 月 20 日截止，合约截止为 11 月 21 日；未领取的 FABLES 将不再铸造。仅限已攒积分的老参与者，按官方领取页操作，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: FABLES points claiming and PROLOGUE redemption close Nov 20 (contract deadline Nov 21); unclaimed FABLES will not be minted. Existing points holders only — use the official claim page and beware of phishing.

desc_zh: 北京时间 11 月 20 日 17:00，Deribit 约 2.83 万枚 BTC 期权到期，最大痛点 73000 美元；到期前后现货价格常向最大痛点附近靠拢，留意波动。
desc_en: About 28,300 BTC in Deribit options expire at 09:00 CET on Nov 20, with max pain at $73,000; spot prices often drift toward max pain around expiry — expect volatility.

title_zh: 美国密歇根大学 11 月消费者信心指数
title_en: University of Michigan November consumer sentiment
desc_zh: 密歇根大学发布 11 月消费者信心指数，反映美国家庭对通胀与就业的预期；信心走弱通常利空风险资产，留意其对 12 月加息预期的影响。
desc_en: The University of Michigan releases its November consumer sentiment index, reflecting US households' expectations on inflation and jobs; weaker confidence usually weighs on risk assets and feeds into December hike expectations.
Official listing on Nov 21; final snapshot Nov 11, wMNEMO must be claimed by Nov 10, wallet registration Nov 12–17. Follow the official timeline.

desc_zh: 获俄罗斯央行批准交易规则的交易所自 11 月 22 日起可开展有组织加密交易；11 月 17 日起散户已可在年度限额内购买 BTC、ETH 与 USDT，具体参与资格与交易规则以俄央行与交易所公告为准。
desc_en: Exchanges whose trading rules are approved by the Bank of Russia may start organized crypto trading from Nov 22; retail investors can already buy BTC, ETH and USDT within annual limits since Nov 17. Exact eligibility and rules follow Bank of Russia and exchange announcements.

desc_zh: 据报道 OKXICE 将于 11 月 23 日启动代币化证券交易，覆盖美股七巨头在内的 65 家以上公司；具体上线标的与参与门槛以官方公告为准。
desc_en: OKXICE is reported to launch tokenized securities trading on Nov 23, covering 65+ companies including the Magnificent Seven; exact listings and access rules follow official announcements.

desc_zh: Arthur Hayes 创立的 AI 算力链 FLOP Network 计划 11 月 24 日启动测试网（此前 11 月 3 日目标已跳票，日期仍为暂定）；测试网挖矿可分 44 亿枚 FLOP 创世空投（矿工/代理/验证者各 12 亿 + 8 亿储备），主网与 TGE 日期尚未确认。参与前以官方页为准，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: FLOP Network, the AI compute chain founded by Arthur Hayes, plans to start its testnet on Nov 24 (a Nov 3 target already slipped, so the date is tentative); testnet mining earns a share of a 4.4B FLOP genesis airdrop (1.2B each for miners, agents and validators plus an 0.8B reserve). Mainnet and TGE dates are unconfirmed. Verify on official pages and beware of phishing.

title_zh: 以太坊核心开发者再议 Glamsterdam 升级方案
title_en: Ethereum core developers reconvene on Glamsterdam scope
desc_zh: 以太坊核心开发者 11 月 26 日开会拍板 Glamsterdam 升级是否修改技术规范：维持现有规范则主网最早 2027 年 1 月中旬激活，改规范则可能推迟至 2027 年 4–5 月；争议焦点是 EIP-8037/8038 的 Gas 计价改动可能波及约 1.5 万个智能合约。
desc_en: Ethereum core developers meet Nov 26 to decide whether to revise Glamsterdam's specifications: keeping them could activate mainnet as early as mid-January 2027, while revisions could push it to April-May 2027. At issue are EIP-8037/8038 gas-repricing changes that could affect about 15,000 smart contracts.

title_zh: Doppler Finance（XDP）创世空投领取截止
title_en: Doppler Finance (XDP) Genesis Airdrop claim closes
desc_zh: Doppler Finance 创世空投（1 亿枚 XDP，占总量 1%，Base 网络）领取于 11 月 28 日截止。仅限已获分配的老参与者，按官方领取页操作，谨防钓鱼网站。
desc_en: Doppler Finance's Genesis Airdrop claim (100M XDP, 1% of supply, on Base) closes Nov 28. Allocated participants only — use the official claim page and beware of phishing sites.

desc_en: Incentiv's mainnet XP campaign Epoch 0 closes Nov 30 at 10:00 UTC; the XP route requires at least 1,000 XP to qualify, but reaching it does not guarantee an allocation — amounts and claim dates are unannounced, with rewards on a 3-month cliff plus 12 months linear vesting. Use the official portal only and beware of phishing.

title_zh: MSCI 剔除 Strategy（MSTR）正式生效
title_en: MSCI removal of Strategy (MSTR) takes effect
desc_zh: MSCI 11 月指数评审的剔除决定于 11 月 30 日收盘生效，Strategy 将退出 MSCI USA、MSCI World 与 ACWI 指数；跟踪指数的基金须在此之前完成调仓，摩根大通估算被动抛售约 28 亿美元。剔除不等于退市，也不强制 Strategy 卖出比特币。
desc_en: MSCI's November review removal takes effect at the Nov 30 close: Strategy exits the MSCI USA, World and ACWI indexes; index-tracking funds must rebalance by then, with JPMorgan estimating about $2.8B in passive selling. Removal is not a delisting and does not force Strategy to sell bitcoin.

title_zh: LayerZero Zero 主网与 lzATLAS 上线
title_en: LayerZero Zero mainnet and lzATLAS launch
desc_zh: LayerZero 自有 Layer 1 区块链 Zero 计划 11 月 30 日上线主网，首个应用 lzATLAS 交易所引擎同步上线，初始接入十余家交易场所；这是网络与产品上线，并非空投，LayerZero 尚未公布第二轮 ZRO 空投。只认官方渠道，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: LayerZero's own Layer 1, Zero, is scheduled to launch mainnet on Nov 30 with its first app, the lzATLAS exchange engine, onboarding more than a dozen trading venues at launch. This is a network and product launch, not an airdrop — LayerZero has announced no second ZRO airdrop. Use official channels only and beware of phishing.

Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

title_zh: 美国 11 月非农就业报告
desc_zh: 美国劳工统计局发布 11 月非农就业与失业率（美东时间 8:30），是 12 月 8–9 日 FOMC 会议前最后一份就业数据；10 月非农超预期大增 16.5 万人已把 12 月加息概率推至约 79%，本份数据将直接决定 12 月是否加息。
desc_en: BLS releases November nonfarm payrolls and unemployment (8:30 a.m. ET) — the last jobs print before the Dec 8–9 FOMC meeting. October's blowout 165,000 gain already lifted December hike odds to about 79%; this report will decide whether the Fed hikes in December.

desc_zh: 约 1670 万枚 PIEVERSE 解锁，价值约 2820 万美元，占流通量约 6.07%，为团队与投资者的第二次月度释放，比例较高，潜在抛压需警惕。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~16.7M PIEVERSE unlock (~$28.2M, ~6.07% of circulating supply) — the second monthly team and investor release, a high ratio; watch closely for potential sell pressure. Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 约 1.27 亿枚 STRK 月度释放，价值约 420 万美元，占流通量约 1.7%，释放给投资者与早期贡献者；按计划月度释放持续至 2027 年 3 月最后一批。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~127M STRK monthly release (~$4.2M, ~1.7% of circulating supply) to investors and early contributors; monthly tranches run until the final one in March 2027. Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

title_zh: Galxe 奖励领取关闭、网站转为只读
title_en: Galxe reward claims close; site goes read-only
desc_zh: Galxe 宣布并入 Gravity：12 月 5 日为参与活动的最后一天，12 月 15 日奖励领取关闭、整个 Galxe 网站转为只读；未领取的奖励能否追回官方尚未说明，参与者请在 12 月 15 日前完成领取，并以官方 X 公告为准。
desc_en: Galxe is consolidating under Gravity: Dec 5 is the last day to take part in campaigns, and on Dec 15 reward claims close and the whole Galxe site goes read-only. Whether unclaimed rewards remain recoverable is unannounced — claim before Dec 15 and follow the official X announcements.

desc_zh: 约 9260 万枚 ARB 月度解锁，价值约 1210 万美元，占流通量约 1.3%，释放给团队、顾问与投资者；按每月约此规模的节奏持续至 2027 年 3 月。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~92.6M ARB monthly unlock (~$12.1M, ~1.3% of circulating supply) to team, advisors and investors, on a monthly cadence until March 2027. Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

title_zh: 美国 11 月零售销售发布
desc_zh: 美国人口普查局发布 11 月零售销售（美东时间 8:30，北京时间 21:30），是首份覆盖假日季的消费数据；10 月仅增 0.2%，市场关注消费是否在加息预期升温下走弱。
desc_en: The US Census Bureau releases November retail sales (8:30 a.m. ET) — the first read on holiday-season spending. October rose just 0.2%; markets watch whether consumption is weakening as hike expectations rise.

desc_zh: 约 1.73 亿枚 ZK 解锁，价值约 130 万美元，占流通量约 1.6%，释放给投资者与团队。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~173M ZK unlock (~$1.3M, ~1.6% of circulating supply) to investors and team. Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: 约 3.333 亿枚 UNITE 解锁，占总供应量约 1.1%、约流通市值 37%，为私募投资者的悬崖解锁；相对市值比例极高，潜在抛压需高度警惕。解锁不等于抛售，但短期波动值得留意。
desc_en: ~333.3M UNITE unlock (~1.1% of total supply, ~37% of market cap) — a cliff unlock to private investors. An extremely high ratio against market cap; watch closely for potential sell pressure. Unlocks don't equal sells, but short-term volatility is worth watching.

desc_zh: Predict.fun Season 1 领取窗口于 12 月 18 日 09:00（UTC）关闭（TGE 开启后 30 天），逾期未领视为放弃。仅限已获分配的老参与者，只认官方领取页 predict.fun/points/airdrop，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: Predict.fun's Season 1 claim window closes Dec 18 at 09:00 UTC (30 days after opening at TGE); unclaimed allocations are forfeited. Allocated participants only — official claim page predict.fun/points/airdrop only, beware of phishing.
